description: Source code implementing certificate verification procedures for iOS within Chromium, including error mapping, trust evaluation, and certificate chain analysis.

classes.name: CertVerifyProcIOS
classes.description: Implements certificate verification logic specific to iOS, including error mapping, trust evaluation, and chain analysis.

methods.name: CertVerifyProcIOS::GetCertFailureStatusFromError
methods.description: Maps a CFErrorRef error to a CertStatus code based on the error domain and code.

methods.name: CertVerifyProcIOS::GetCertFailureStatusFromTrust
methods.description: Analyzes a SecTrustRef to determine the reason for trust failure, converting it into a CertStatus code.

methods.name: CertVerifyProcIOS::SupportsAdditionalTrustAnchors
methods.description: Indicates whether additional trust anchors are supported (returns false).

methods.name: CertVerifyProcIOS::VerifyInternal
